description: A 4×4 composite of EBSD maps from the same low-density δ-ferrite steel rolled at four temperatures (rows labelled R650, R750, R850, R950), each panel carrying a 20 µm scale bar. Columns are headed GB, KAM, IPF and NI. (a–d) are GB + GOS maps: grey lines are boundaries of 2–15° misorientation, black lines >15°, and solid green areas mark GOS ≤ 2°; the green GOS≤2° fraction grows conspicuously from (a) through (c) and (d). (e–h) are KAM maps using a "Kernel Aver. Misorient." colour bar from 0 (dark blue) to 4.99 (°) (red); (e, f) are almost uniformly dark blue while (g, h) contain slightly more light-green patches. (i–l) are IPF maps coloured with an "IPF Colouring | 2D, Iron bcc (old), Iron fcc" key whose triangle corners are 001, 101 and 111; (i, j) are dominated by fine red/purple lamellar bands, whereas (k) and (l) show coarser, more equiaxed multi-coloured grains. (m–p) repeat the IPF colouring with black dot arrays marking nanoindentation imprints. Together the panels link rolling temperature to grain-boundary character, misorientation, texture and local hardness.

observations.observation: The figure is a 4×4 grid of EBSD-derived maps: column headers read GB, KAM, IPF and NI, and row labels read R650, R750, R850 and R950; every one of the 16 panels carries a 20 µm scale bar.
The GB-map legend defines grey lines as 2–15°, black lines as >15°, and solid green as GOS≤2°.
Green GOS≤2° area visibly increases from the top row (a, R650) to the bottom row (d, R950) of the GB column.
The KAM colour bar is labelled "Kernel Aver. Misorient." and spans 0 to 4.99 (°) (dark blue to red); it is shared by panels (e–h) and no per-panel numeric values are printed.
The IPF colour key is labelled "IPF Colouring | 2D, Iron bcc (old), Iron fcc" with triangle corners 001, 101 and 111.
Panels (m–p) show the same IPF colouring as (i–l) with black dot arrays marking nanoindentation imprints.
IPF maps (i) and (j) are dominated by fine red/purple lamellar bands, whereas (k) and (l) contain markedly coarser, more equiaxed grains coloured green, cyan, blue and pink.
The caption states the panel grouping: (a–d) GB + GOS maps, (e–h) KAM maps, (i–l) IPF maps, and (m–p) IPF maps of nanoindentation.

The citing text reports HAGB proportions of 43.5–49.6 % in the low-temperature rolling zone versus 60.1–75.7 % in the high-temperature rolling zone (Table 3) — a value that is not printed anywhere in the figure.
The citing text reports an average KAM of 0.48–0.55° for the low-temperature rolling zone (Fig. 4e–f) decreasing to 0.3–0.4° for the high-temperature rolling zone (Fig. 4g–h).
The citing text reports the GOS<2° proportion rising from 6.9–12.3 % (low-temperature zone) to 19.4–25.8 % (high-temperature zone), consistent with the visually larger green areas in (c, d).
The citing text states the dominant grain orientation shifts from <001> in the low-temperature rolling zone to <101> with increasing rolling temperature (Fig. 4i–l).
The citing text assigns nano-hardness values in the low-temperature zone: carbide/ferrite composite lamellae 3.64 GPa versus δ-ferrite lamellae 2.92–2.93 GPa (difference 0.72 GPa).

The citing text assigns hardness in the high-temperature zone in the order martensite (5.98–6.50 GPa) > DIF (2.84–2.98 GPa) > δ-ferrite (2.64–2.77 GPa), with a maximum difference of 3.86 GPa (Fig. 4m–p).
No numeric hardness values are printed on panels (m–p); only the positions of the nanoindentation imprints are shown on the IPF maps.

subfigures.description: GB + GOS map of R650: grey 2–15° and black >15° boundary network with scattered green GOS≤2° regions in a mostly white matrix; 20 µm scale bar.
GB + GOS map of R750: similar boundary network to (a) with sparse green GOS≤2° areas; 20 µm scale bar.
GB + GOS map of R850: noticeably larger green GOS≤2° fields, some banded, in a white matrix; 20 µm scale bar.
GB + GOS map of R950: extensive green GOS≤2° bands dominating the upper part of the map; 20 µm scale bar.
KAM map of R650: nearly uniform dark blue (low kernel average misorientation) with faint lamellar streaks; 20 µm scale bar.
KAM map of R750: nearly uniform dark blue with faint lamellar streaks; 20 µm scale bar.
KAM map of R850: dark blue base with slightly more light-green patches than (e, f); 20 µm scale bar.
KAM map of R950: dark blue base with visible light-green patches and fine linear features; 20 µm scale bar.
IPF map of R650: fine red/purple lamellar banded grains with minor green/blue regions; 20 µm scale bar.
IPF map of R750: banded red/purple lamellae plus a prominent horizontal pink-red band; 20 µm scale bar.
IPF map of R850: coarse, more equiaxed multi-coloured grains (green, cyan, purple) with lamellar remnants; 20 µm scale bar.
IPF map of R950: large elongated grains coloured green, blue and pink, indicating grain growth; 20 µm scale bar.
IPF map of R650 overlaid with black nanoindentation dots arranged along a line/array; 20 µm scale bar.
IPF map of R750 with black nanoindentation dot arrays over the banded structure; 20 µm scale bar.
IPF map of R850 with black nanoindentation dots on coarse equiaxed grains; 20 µm scale bar.
IPF map of R950 with black nanoindentation dots spanning large grains of different colours; 20 µm scale bar.

Per-panel numeric KAM or GOS values are not printed on any of the 16 maps; only the shared 0–4.99° colour bar is available
Individual nanoindentation hardness values are not annotated on panels (m–p)
